_note: Each province's resources (src/geo/provinceResources.ts, docs/PROVINCE_PROFILE.md), at levels 0-5. 'levels' are the owner's own, set on the admin page (admin.html under npm run dev) and win over everything. 'inferred' are the game's guesses where open map data says nothing: wind, lignite, oil and gas, potash and rock salt, tin, zinc and lead, gold, gems, from widely known public information, not from surveys; rare earths are made up for the game. Everything else comes from data/geo/province-indicators.json. '_why' says where a guess comes from.

TH-19._why: limestone and the cement industry around Kaeng Khoi

TH-21._why: gas from the Gulf comes ashore; petrochemical estates

TH-30._why: wind farms on the plateau edge; potash and rock salt of the Khorat basin

TH-36._why: wind farms in the hills; potash

TH-41._why: a gas field; the largest potash deposit

TH-52._why: the big lignite mine and power plant

TH-63._why: zinc mining, and the cadmium it left in the fields

TH-71._why: lead and tin in the western hills; sapphire

TH-90._why: gas from the Gulf comes ashore
